reusable: Original PROPOSE/APPROVE/REVOKE/CONSUME bounded immutable ledger, CAS/idempotency, exact command and current source snapshot.
Original issued temporary own-PG/Case scope and default-disabled adapter.
Original resource locks, capacity confirm receipt and atomic first Case binder.
Original strict current binding comparison, immutable link snapshots, source impacts and old occupancy preservation.
Original guarded Store.commit recheck and cooperative catalog publication locks.
Original P1 gate, affected step VERIFY, actual receipt sources and six-goal/worklist readers.
selected_root_design: Explicit after-link new HELD confirmation + exact current link rebind + new-purpose Approval consumption in original transaction; no standalone already-confirmed rebind approval-only claim.

challenges.finding: Existing Approval covers exact first delivery only; no existing after-link reapproval/consumption path.
basis: case_resource_delivery._candidate rejects existing Case link history
challenges.required: Explicit new opt-in after-link HELD-confirmation profile; never silently widen original first-only semantics.

challenges.finding: A self-hashed local ADOPT event or affected list is not original source proof.
challenges.required: Unconditionally run original steps._recovery_proofs and fixed historical compilers; require current latest ADOPT is exact opportunity local source change, P2 affected, later revision than original delivered approved plan revision. Reject searching backwards past a newer incompatible ADOPT.

challenges.finding: Final commit guard must distinguish exact own link insertion from concurrent or forged latest history.
challenges.required: Bind prior latest link UUID/revision/full snapshot and original receipt; permit own precise expected-revision+1 link only with matching actor/key/fingerprint/consumption event/actual original effect. Never generically drop latest link.

challenges.finding: Optional expected_link_revision must not accidentally enable new profile when Approval adapter or dedicated flag is absent.
challenges.required: Non-None positive revision requires original enabled issued fixture adapter and explicit source-reapproval flag before any new effect; first request exclude_none fingerprints unchanged.

challenges.finding: Receipt/link history integrity must be checked through P2, goals and recovery, not only approval endpoint.
challenges.required: New approval purpose preserves strict original receipt shape/history dispatch; after-link actual bundle receipt, ledger consumption and inserted link all agree. Missing or rehashed detached proof rejects read/VERIFY.

challenges.finding: Current source and authority can change during locks, or revoke/restore to same visible values.
challenges.required: Retain original principal/capability/preparation/resource permission checks, row-version and epoch bindings, cooperative catalog lock and final guarded commit time/TTL recheck; do not grant permissions or treat old approved status as current authority.

challenges.finding: Reapproval must preserve old confirmed occupancy and consumed historical facts.
challenges.required: New HELD members confirm and original Case rebind plus CONSUME are one transaction; no automatic release or cancellation of old occupancy; failure restores all newly attempted effects while retaining old history.

challenges.finding: The necessary action order includes plan/source repair before proposal approval.
challenges.required: Actual source update and explicit original opportunity refresh/local ADOPT, original P1 VERIFY, new proposal and explicit APPROVE, original capacity COMMIT/rebind, affected original VERIFY and six goals/worklist. Later ADOPT/VERIFY before consuming must stale exact plan-revision approval.

minimum_rejection_matrix: Wrong owner/tenant/Case/Run/role, withdrawn READ/EXECUTE/PREPARE/resource permissions including recovery.
New profile without explicit flag/issued adapter; old first-profile approval substituted for after-link or reverse.
Missing/stripped/rehashed original prior delivery receipt and approval consumption; unsupported legacy direct link.
Stale prior link revision or UUID; concurrent substitute; exact command member/order/reason/valid_until mismatch.
Latest ADOPT missing, not opportunity local source change, P2 unaffected, too old, downgraded/forged history or newer incompatible ADOPT.
Expired original new quote/hold before or during final lock; current source versions changed; ABA and revoke/restore.
Same key changed profile/link revision/body; cross-Case key reuse; duplicate consume with different key.
Late HTTP403/success after identity ABA or Case switch; unknown write recovery uses only original keyed GET.
Invalid or unknown source graph, unsupported catalog replacement, manual locked affected step, cancelled/reconciling Case.
Failure after resource confirmation or link insert must roll back new group/link/claim/consume together; historical original remains.
limits: No execution tests in this scope review.
Default legacy independent bind remains original outside explicitly enabled new scope.
Only cooperative catalog/owner protocol closes last-read-to-COMMIT; noncooperative trusted owner remains outside guarantee.
